_doctrine: Source-anchored TRIAGE BUFFER for substances a Wallach claim NAMES that are NOT yet registered in eden/catalog/nutrients.json. This file is NOT a source of truth: the references_resolve gate NEVER reads it, so the single substance registry stays nutrients.json alone (no drift, no second definition). While mining, a substance with no registry slug (a genuine new herb Wallach names, OR book-OCR garbage) is PARKED here with full source context and left OUT of the claim's other_substances FOR NOW, so references_resolve stays green while the claim still seals. The substance_triage_accounted gate keeps this pile VISIBLE + un-forgettable: while a book is mining_status:'incomplete' the pending count is informational (never RED), but the moment a book is flagged COMPLETE, every entry for it MUST be resolved (a real substance promoted to nutrients.json + backfilled into its claim) or rejected (OCR garbage / not-a-substance) with a written reason -- an unresolved pending entry under a complete book is RED. This makes the HONEST path the path of LEAST resistance: park-it-cheaply (via eden/tools/substance_triage.py park) beats BOTH typo-polluting the registry AND silently dropping the substance. Resolution = batch-review each entry against the source page IMAGE (never against the OCR text), fix OCR typos, promote real substances via the catalog + re-seal, backfill into the claim's other_substances via mine_batch.
_schema: entries[]: { id:'STB-####', raw_name, book_id, locator, context, claim_id (str|null), noticed_at (ISO date), status:'pending'|'resolved'|'rejected', resolution (str; REQUIRED non-empty once status != 'pending') }
